description: NNCP GGML open CPU kernel closure
hypothesis: A clean MIT GGML source closure can build a CPU-only static runtime and execute the fixed NNCP-relevant forward, cross-entropy backward, and AdamW update probe twice with byte-identical state within a 2000000-byte compressed source package.

interfaces_exposed: MIT GGML source closure -> deterministic CPU forward/backward/AdamW substrate for an NNCP-shaped parity probe
